verdict.rationale: The evidence covers data export and backup (SQL dumps, code and database export) and SQL write access, but none of it documents retention settings or a way to delete account or project data held by Floot. Export and portability are adjacent to retention and deletion control, not the capability itself. Running SQL writes on an app database is a developer building block, not a platform deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
